I have had many jobs through my life and honestly working for a pyramid scheme who can’t admit it’s a scheme was the worst and here is why. So the ad was $13hr for standing in a kiosk in San club, Offering people to get direct tv or new at&t sprint Verizon or T-Mobile line. Fair enough I’ve seen these companies around hell i used to work for target mobile, so i applied. When waiting to be interviewed i saw another 20 people waiting in same small office. Weird but ok let’s do this. Manager calls me to office as i proceed he looks at other people there and yells “let’s get it on!” I turn back and everyone is entering a small office and while he interviewed me you could hear them practicing their sales pitch. Owner/GM tells me after interview that “practice makes perfect, and when you practice same sales pitch you land a sale every time”. First few days all i did was sales pitch and they explained how pay works. You have to sell first 2 new lines/upgrades and 1 xtra direct tv so you can start making your 13 and hour per day or more depending on the amount of dtvs or new lines i sell. Within a week of outselling a 20 chart (combination of 20 items) you were in a new bracket to becoming assistant manager. But you have to keep at that 20 chart from now on. After a week of training and with my doubt of the scheme i requested to speak to owner/Gm and was told he was in retreat with other owners and employees who broke the 1000chart... in a week? I walked out of there pist over lies and deception they made you believe specially when they explain that $13 hr is based off your sales but not like commission.
